decision_table.name: Determine_WV_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file West Virginia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in WV (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
WV filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
A corporation has physical presence nexus in WV if it has: - An office, store, warehouse, or other place of business in WV - Employees working in WV - Tangible personal property located in WV - Real property located in WV
Reference: WV Code § 11-24-7 (Nexus and apportionment) Reference: WV Tax Division Corporate Income Tax Guidance

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
WV filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in WV.
Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), WV requires filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: WV Tax Division Economic Nexus Guidance

No WV nexus - no filing requirement.
Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: WV Code § 11-24-7 (Nexus requirements)

decision_table.name: Calculate_WV_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate WV state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
WV state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
WV ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: - Federal net operating loss deduction (WV has separate NOL rules) - Foreign taxes deducted on federal return (not allowed as WV deduction) - State income taxes deducted on federal return - Interest on obligations of other states (exempt federally, taxable to WV) - Expenses related to exempt income - Certain bonus depreciation adjustments (varies by tax year)
WV SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: - Qualified Opportunity Zone business income (WV Code § 11-24-6) - Foreign source income (income from sources outside the United States) - Interest on WV state and municipal bonds - WV net operating loss deduction (subject to WV limitations) - Certain dividend income adjustments
Reference: WV Form CIT-120 Schedule B (Adjustments to Federal Taxable Income) Reference: WV Code § 11-24-6 (Adjustments increasing federal taxable income) Reference: WV Code § 11-24-6 (Adjustments decreasing federal taxable income)

No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.
Corporation does not have WV nexus, so no income adjustments are needed.

decision_table.name: Calculate_WV_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate WV state corporate income tax. Applies WV 6.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
WV state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to WV: × [WV apportionment percentage] 3. WV additions: + [Federal NOL, foreign taxes, state taxes, etc.] 4. WV subtractions: - [QOZ income, foreign source income, WV municipal interest, etc.] 5. WV taxable income: = [Result] 6. WV tax rate: × 6.5% 7. WV income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. WV credits: - [Economic development, jobs, R&D, historic preservation, etc.] 9. WV tax liability: = [Final tax]
WV uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor) effective for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2022. The sales factor for service activities uses market-based sourcing (allocation based on market) rather than cost-of-performance sourcing.
WV tax rate history: - 2025: 6.5% - 2026 (proposed): 3.25% (per HB 3293, if enacted) - Historical rates have varied over time
WV provides various tax credits including: - Economic development tax credits - Jobs creation tax credits - Research and development credits - Historic rehabilitation tax credits - Manufacturing investment tax credits
Reference: WV Form CIT-120 (Corporation Net Income Tax Return) Reference: WV Code § 11-24-4 (Tax rate of 6.5%) Reference: WV Code § 11-24-7 (Single-sales apportionment effective 2022+) Reference: WV Tax Division Corporate Tax Guidance

No WV nexus - no tax liability.
Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in WV. Any estimated payments are refunded.
Reference: WV Code § 11-24-7 (Nexus requirements)

No WV taxable income - no tax liability.
Corporation has WV nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded.
WV net operating loss (NOL) rules may apply: - WV allows NOL carryforward (separate from federal NOL rules) - Federal NOL is added back to federal taxable income - WV NOL is then subtracted as a decreasing adjustment - Specific carryforward/carryback periods governed by WV law
Reference: WV Form CIT-120 (Corporation Net Income Tax Return) Reference: WV Code § 11-24-6 (NOL adjustments)
